Mine had some rough and sharp unfinished areas around the top edge so that is why only 3 stars. A minute of sanding with some 600 grit wet/dry paper removed those. I can still feel and see one bad area but it is no longer sharp and not at the spout. Otherwise the pitcher is just the right size. I already had 6 other frothing pitchers but needed a 12oz and this is just the right height and volume. Unlike my other's, there is no stamped marking on the bottom at all - usually I see the grade and type of metal and the country of origin (typically  "18/8 stainless steel made in china") but mine has nothing there. Regardless, it is fairly heavy gauge ss with 2 solid spot welds at each end of the handle attaching it to the pitcher, and it feels good in the hand. The spout is decent shape for pouring latte art, so overall a good value for the money.

Firstly, am not sure if I’ve previously written a review for this sealer. If so, I’m certain it was 5 stars!! We have this 16” sealer as well as two 8” sealers, and seems we’re grabbing one most every day. One nice thing that many folks may not have thought of is, these sealers will seal potato chip bags! Why would you want to? Well, for us, trash food scraps can be put in empty food bags (such as from chips) and sealed, keeping any odor locked inside.

We have a new litter of kittens and there was some food that sat out too long and I didn’t want to trust. So found a chip bag, dumped the old kitten chow in (water-soaked dry food mixed with canned paté) and sealed it up. …Or at least that was the plan.

We’ve had this sealer for 3 years and I’ve never had a problem. This time, I ended up cutting my finger on a piece of metal left over from the manufacturing process. On the bottom are two oblong holes. Each hole had excess metal that was not removed. Well, guess my tough-as-leather skin is no more, cause I got a cut. First couple of days went well but today is day 3 and it’s quite painful.

To remedy the problem, I took a pair of needle nose pliers and, using the rounded nose, formed the metal fragments up into the sealer housing. Now the unit will be safe for anyone to handle….even me! LOL

As mentioned, we have this 16” sealer as well as two smaller 8” sealers. Other than this issue, can’t say enough good about them. Wonderful tools. J
